title: The HERITAGE CONSERVATION AND PRESERVATION ACT, 2010 (Act No. XV of 2010)
full_text: The HERITAGE CONSERVATION AND PRESERVATION ACT, 2010 (Act No. XV of 2010) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201015 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 2010-04-28 Act Year: 2010 Short Title: The HERITAGE CONSERVATION AND PRESERVATION ACT, 2010 (Act No. XV of 2010) Long Title: An Act to provide for conservation and preservation of heritage both tangible and intangible, including buildings, structures, monuments, precincts, areas/sites, artifacts, sculptures, paintings, handicrafts, manuscripts etc. and music, dance, drama, performing arts, poetry, living traditions like crafts and cuisine, traditional knowledge systems, folklores, spiritual traditionsrespectively of historic or cultural or religious or aesthetic or architectural or environmental significance and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Culture Enforcement Date: 29-04-2010 Type: STATE Location: Jammu and Kashmir TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1.
